summary: This project aims to tell the stories or tales of lost machines in space which was send over by NASA to complete exploration missions or to aid other space missions. We developed a simple website which can be used to store and read about the tale or information about these machines such as rovers and other spacecraft.
details:
This website is a platform to store information about all missions that involves these spacecrafts which has its missions ended for them. The website simply stores stories and information about such machines. This project is intended to provide a platform or like a Wiki for lost space machines.

for this project we used tools like Canva to edit ppt.

we used HTML,CSS and Java in the making of this website.

and VS code as a integrated development and learning environment and GitHub to host the website.

I don't consider the Project to be overly creative but its a simply approach to make information such as these very easy.
